title: Brand configuration
description: Every user-visible product string. lib/brand.ts is the only module allowed to read this file; nothing else may hardcode the name, the domain or the npm package.

name.description: Full product name, as written in prose.

shortName.description: Bare name without the `ui.` prefix. Also the CLI bin name — must not contain a dot, because cmd.exe reads everything after the last dot as a file extension and refuses to run it.

wordmark.description: The name as it is set in the header lockup.

legalEntity.description: Name used in the copyright line and legal pages.

domain.description: Bare hostname, no scheme and no trailing slash.

origin.description: Production origin. Overridden at build time by NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN when a preview deploy needs its own absolute URLs.

npmPackage.description: Published package name. This is what a user types after `npx`.

social.description: Profile URLs. Every key is optional on purpose — an unclaimed handle should be absent, not present and returning 404. The footer renders only the keys it finds.
